Class SpotLight

java.lang.Object
lighting.PointLight
lighting.SpotLight
All Implemented Interfaces:
LightSource
public class SpotLight extends PointLight
Represents a spot light source (e.g., a flashlight). It is a point light with a specific direction of illumination and optional narrow beam support. * @author פרויקט מבוא להנדסת תוכנה
